column1: # Command-predication streams and what Metal ran for each, on an Apple M3 Max under macOS 27.0.1
# (Apple9), one command buffer per stream, our own synthetic kernel marking tags: the Metal
# platform's probe (`metal::platform::predication_tests`) measures them, and the runtime lane
# (`runtime_lane::predication`) asserts the runtime runs the same. Columns, tab-separated: the
# probe's name, the stream (the notation of `runtime_lane::predication::run`), the tags that ran
# (each once, ascending, comma-separated), and what the Ends answered (1 YES, 0 NO, in order).
# Hand-written streams first, then three seeded random sets (`g`, `h`: unbalanced records among
# valid blocks; `k`: misused records, fence updates and indirect dispatches too). Only streams whose
# command buffer completes are here: none that ends a unit with a block open whose commands skip (a
# GPU recovery on Metal, `CommandBufferError::PredicationOpenAtUnitEnd`). The `x` rows' unit's first
# record is unbalanced after dispatches of the unit, which Metal drops.
